section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measures used in the current study, including demographic data collection (age, gender, nationality, residence, education, weight, height for BMI) and several self-report scales. It describes the Early Memories of Warmth and Safeness Scale (EMWSS), EMWSS-Peers version, Social Safeness and Pleasure Scale (SSPS), Body Appreciation Scale (BAS-2), and Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q), providing information on their items, response scales, and internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha) in the original, Portuguese, and current study versions. The text consistently refers to 'the current study', indicating a single study.
